subject: E-Commerce
title: Resale and Circular Commerce
description: A short lesson to help you apply Resale and Circular Commerce.

hook.text: The resale market will reach $350 billion by 2027. Secondhand shopping grew 25x faster than traditional retail.

buildup.text: ThredUp, The RealReal, and Poshmark turned used goods into a mainstream shopping category.

discovery.text: Brands now launch their own resale programs. Patagonia's Worn Wear and Levi's SecondHand sell pre-owned items directly.

twist.text: Resale cannibalizes new sales. When customers buy used Patagonia, that's one fewer new jacket sold.

climax.text: Circular commerce extends product life & reduces waste. Brands must choose between sustainability claims & new sales.

punchline.text: $350B, 25x faster growth. Resale is booming and brands must join or lose.

quiz.question: What dilemma does resale create for brands?
options: Pre-owned sales from their own programs cannibalize new product purchases
